data.name: Niravika
data.gender_notes: Niravika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Niravika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nir' meaning liberation and 'avika' meaning free from sorrow. This name is often given to girls to signify hope and deliverance from pain and suffering. The name Niravika carries the meaning “Liberation from sorrow” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Niravika usually hope their child will grow to embody liberation from sorrow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Niravika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberation from sorrow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niravika total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The name embodies the notion of hope and deliverance from suffering that is revered in this ancient civilization.

The name is a reminder of the ultimate goal of Hinduism – to achieve Moksha or salvation.
